Greater Manchester Pension Fund (GMPF) has committed £30m to the core-plus strategy of Newcore Capital, the B Corp-certified UK social infrastructure investment manager. The investment is split evenly between the Newcore Social Infrastructure Income Fund (NSIIF) and a regional sidecar, the NSIIF North West Co-investment Partnership (NNCP).
